tools.name: create_clip_link
tools.description: Return a Gimmeclip selection link for 0.5–60 seconds of a public YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Bluesky, VK, LinkedIn or Weibo video. Read llms_full_txt first to choose source-video timestamps. The user opens the link to preview, adjust and create the clip. Does not render, download, or ve

tools.name: llms_txt
tools.description: Get an llms.txt index for any link: title, one-line summary, and sections of the most useful links with short descriptions. Returns the site’s own llms.txt when it has one. Cached 24h.

tools.name: llms_full_txt
tools.description: Get llms-full.txt for any link: the llms.txt index followed by the full Markdown of up to 20 pages it links to (or the page/document itself; for a video, its description and timestamped transcript). Can be large — prefer llms_txt when you only need to find pages. Cached 24h.

tools.name: video_frame
tools.description: Get one frame of a video (YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, a direct .mp4 link…) as a JPEG image, to see what is on screen at a given time. Pair with llms_full_txt: the transcript is timestamped.

tools.name: check_llms_txt
tools.description: Check an llms.txt against the format (H1 title, blockquote summary, H2 sections of `- [name](url): notes` links) and size. Pass `url` to check the file a site publishes, including whether its first 25 links answer; or pass `text` to check a file you have (a draft, a local copy), with `base` for wher
